';
const canvas=document.getElementById('c'),load=document.getElementById('load'),phase=document.getElementById('phase'),stats=document.getElementById('stats');
const img=new Image();img.onerror=()=>load.textContent='TRACE MAP ERROR';img.onload=()=>{try{
  load.textContent='BUILDING GPU PARTICLE BUFFER…';const tmp=document.createElement('canvas');tmp.width=MW;tmp.height=MH;const cx=tmp.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});cx.drawImage(img,0,0,MW,MH);const px=cx.getImageData(0,0,MW,MH).data;
  const scores=new Uint8Array(MW*MH),counts=new Uint32Array(256);let valid=0;
  for(let i=0,p=0;i<scores.length;i++,p+=4){const r=px[p],g=px[p+1],b=px[p+2],m=Math.max(r,g,b),red=Math.max(0,r-(g+b)*.5);let s=Math.min(255,(m+red*.72)|0);if(s<4)s=0;scores[i]=s;if(s){counts[s]++;valid++;}}
  let need=Math.min(MAX,valid),cut=255,above=0;for(let s=255;s>=1;s--){if(above+counts[s]>=need){cut=s;break}above+=counts[s]}
  const N=need,pos=new Float32Array(N*2),meta=new Uint8Array(N*4);let o=0,cutUsed=0,cutNeed=need-above;
  const hash=n=>{const x=Math.sin(n*12.9898+78.233)*43758.5453;return x-Math.floor(x)};
  for(let s=255;s>=cut&&o<N;s--)for(let i=0;i<scores.length&&o<N;i++){if(scores[i]!==s)continue;if(s===cut&&cutUsed++>=cutNeed)continue;const x=i%MW,y=(i/MW)|0,p=i*4;const j=hash(i*1.731+s*2.17),k=hash(i*.713+s*5.91);pos[o*2]=(x+(j-.5)*.78)*3;pos[o*2+1]=(y+(k-.5)*.78)*3;meta[o*4]=px[p];meta[o*4+1]=px[p+1];meta[o*4+2]=px[p+2];meta[o*4+3]=(hash(i*3.17+s*7.1)*255)|0;o++;}
  const gl=canvas.getContext('webgl',{antialias:false,alpha:false,preserveDrawingBuffer:false,powerPreference:'high-performance'});if(!gl)throw Error('WEBGL UNAVAILABLE');
  const VS=`attribute vec2 a;attribute vec4 m;uniform vec2 res;uniform float prog,time,final,diss;varying vec4 vm;float sat(float x){return clamp(x,0.,1.);}float h(float n){return fract(sin(n*12.9898+78.233)*43758.5453);}void main(){vec2 t=vec2(a.x-836,470.5-a.y);float nx=a.x/1672.0,ny=a.y/941.0,dc=abs(nx-.5);float wing=step(.145,dc)*(1.-step(.78,ny));float horn=(1.-step(.17,dc))*(1.-step(.29,ny));float body=(1.-wing)*(1.-horn);float delay=body*(.05+(1.-ny)*.30)+horn*.42+wing*(.53+dc*.20);float f=sat((prog-delay)/max(.08,1.-delay));f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);if(final>.5)f=1.;float sd=m.a*6.28318;float rad=420.+h(m.a*19.1)*620.;vec2 start=vec2(cos(sd)*rad,(h(m.a*33.7)-.5)*1050.);vec2 v=mix(start,t,f);float free=(1.-f)*(1.-final);v+=vec2(cos(time*.21+sd),sin(time*.18+sd*1.13))*free*(9.+26.*h(sd));float dd=sat(diss);v+=normalize(vec2(t.x*.3,t.y+180.))*dd*(80.+420.*h(sd+4.));float aspect=res.x/res.y;float hx=877.8;float hy=494.025;if(hx/hy<aspect)hx=hy*aspect;else hy=hx/aspect;gl_Position=vec4(v.x/hx,v.y/hy,0.,1.);float score=max(m.r,max(m.g,m.b))/255.;gl_PointSize=(1.15+score*1.75+step(.65,m.r/255.)*.55)*(final>.5?1.08:1.);vm=vec4(m.rgb/255.,f*(1.-dd*.78));}`;
  const FS=`precision mediump float;varying vec4 vm;void main(){vec2 q=gl_PointCoord-.5;float d=length(q);if(d>.5)discard;float core=smoothstep(.25,0.,d),halo=smoothstep(.5,.08,d);float src=max(vm.r,max(vm.g,vm.b));float red=max(0.,vm.r-(vm.g+vm.b)*.5);float hot=clamp(src*.85+red*.9,0.,1.);vec3 dark=vec3(.12,.004,.002);vec3 mid=vec3(.60,.025,.008);vec3 fire=vec3(1.,.22,.055);vec3 c=mix(dark,mid,smoothstep(.08,.48,hot));c=mix(c,fire,smoothstep(.55,.95,hot));float a=(.26+halo*.45+core*.45)*(.28+.72*vm.a);gl_FragColor=vec4(c*(.72+halo*.85+core*.8),a);}`;
  function shader(type,src){const s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(s));return s}const pr=gl.createProgram();gl.attachShader(pr,shader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER,VS));gl.attachShader(pr,shader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,FS));gl.linkProgram(pr);if(!gl.getProgramParameter(pr,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(pr));gl.useProgram(pr);
  function attr(name,data,size,type,norm){const b=gl.createBuffer();gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,b);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,data,gl.STATIC_DRAW);const l=gl.getAttribLocation(pr,name);gl.enableVertexAttribArray(l);gl.vertexAttribPointer(l,size,type,norm,0,0)}attr('a',pos,2,gl.FLOAT,false);attr('m',meta,4,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,false);
  const uRes=gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'res'),uP=gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'prog'),uT=gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'time'),uF=gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'final'),uD=gl.getUniformLocation(pr,'diss');gl.enable(gl.BLEND);gl.blendFunc(gl.SRC_ALPHA,gl.ONE);gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
  let quality=2,auto=true,final=false,start=performance.now(),last=performance.now(),frames=0,fps=60,good=0,bad=0;
  function resize(){const cap=innerWidth<700?1:1.22,d=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,cap);canvas.width=Math.max(1,(innerWidth*d)|0);canvas.height=Math.max(1,(innerHeight*d)|0);gl.viewport(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);gl.uniform2f(uRes,canvas.width,canvas.height)}addEventListener('resize',resize);resize();load.remove();
  document.getElementById('final').onclick=()=>final=!final;document.getElementById('restart').onclick=()=>{start=performance.now();final=false};document.getElementById('quality').onclick=()=>{auto=!auto;if(!auto)quality=(quality+1)%3;document.getElementById('quality').textContent=auto?'Quality: Auto':'Quality: '+LAB[quality]};addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='f')final=!final;if(e.key.toLowerCase()==='r'){start=performance.now();final=false}});
  function loop(now){frames++;if(now-last>1000){fps=frames*1000/(now-last);frames=0;last=now;if(auto){if(fps<35){bad++;good=0}else if(fps>56){good++;bad=0}else{good=bad=0}if(bad>=2&&quality>0){quality--;bad=0}if(good>=5&&quality<2){quality++;good=0}}}const t=(now-start)/1000,cy=t%40;let p,d=0;if(cy<26)p=cy/26;else if(cy<33)p=1;else{p=1;d=(cy-33)/7}if(final){p=1;d=0}gl.clearColor(0,0,0,1);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);gl.uniform1f(uP,p);gl.uniform1f(uT,t);gl.uniform1f(uF,final?1:0);gl.uniform1f(uD,d);const draw=Math.min(N,LOD[quality]);gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS,0,draw);phase.textContent=final?'FINAL FORM':d>0?'DISSOLVE':p>=1?'FINAL HOLD':'FORMATION '+Math.floor(p*100)+'%';stats.textContent=draw.toLocaleString()+' GPU particles · '+LAB[quality]+' · '+fps.toFixed(0)+' fps';requestAnimationFrame(loop)}requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}catch(e){console.error(e);load.textContent='ERROR — '+e.message}};img.src=MAP;
})();</script></body></html>
